title: HOW TO #5: Stop a River From Flooding Your Town
caption:
How to stop a river from flooding your town 🌊🧱

The river is rising 10 centimeters every hour. 10 problems, 10 fixes: sandbags with a plastic layer, an earth wall, rocks at the bend, side canals, a settling pond, pumps, a floating barrier for tree trunks. The river stays 1 meter below the wall, and the town stays dry.

Would you have built the wall higher or the canal wider? Comment DIKE below. Tag the friend who lives next to a river. Follow @StickMindR8 for HOW TO #6!
